placements.why: The content establishes rollback rehearsal as an operational reliability practice — mandating monthly cadence and asserting that unreharsed rollbacks are not real. No existing strata category covers operational reliability; this content calls for one.
placements.title: Reliability as practiced discipline
placements.theme: Operational reliability is maintained through rehearsed practice, not assumed capability.

placements.title: Unrehearsed rollbacks are not real rollbacks
placements.theme: A rollback capability exists only insofar as it has been rehearsed; regular practice makes recovery real.
placements.why: src-2 states the principle that an unreharsed rollback is a rollback you do not have; src-1 and src-3 operationalize that principle by establishing monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals as the governing cadence. Together they support a thematic leaf about rollback readiness requiring rehearsal — a subject future envelopes will keep feeding.
